terminals.name: api
terminals.command: source backend/.venv/bin/activate && export DATABASE_URL='postgresql+psycopg2://arl:arl_secure_password@localhost:5432/arl' REDIS_URL='redis://localhost:6379/0' PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend" && cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: source backend/.venv/bin/activate && export DATABASE_URL='postgresql+psycopg2://arl:arl_secure_password@localhost:5432/arl' REDIS_URL='redis://localhost:6379/0' PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend" && cd backend && celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2

terminals.name: beat
terminals.command: source backend/.venv/bin/activate && export DATABASE_URL='postgresql+psycopg2://arl:arl_secure_password@localhost:5432/arl' REDIS_URL='redis://localhost:6379/0' PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend" && cd backend && celery -A app.workers.celery_app beat --loglevel=info
